bead.bead_why: the frame's whole visible face is a 5 px lit sliver, already recorded as frame.hex / face_vs_leaf; there is no separate highlight line inside the reveal

cast.cast_note: raw concrete of the hacked opening running in shadow beside the frame, 30 px at mid height narrowing to 8 px near the head

threshold.threshold_why: no threshold section: the leaves stop 5 px above brown paving with only a dark line between

window.shape: very tall narrow rectangle, moulded surround, 0.76 of leaf height

grille.grille_why: plain clear glazing - the street reads straight through it, no bars or muntins anywhere in the opening

peephole.peephole_why: a glazed lobby door with clear glass full height - swept both leaves at 7x, only the bar and the escutcheon interrupt the paint

hinges.hinges_why: checked the three dark marks on the right stile at 6x - they are the far leaf's glazing bead corners, not hinges; nothing projects past either leaf edge

extras: equal double leaves, both with brushed-steel vertical pull bars
moulded architrave around each glazed slot
hacked concrete opening, frame fixing straps still exposed
notes: Equal-leaf pair; the left leaf carries the lock escutcheon so it was measured as the leaf, its bounds ending at the meeting stile (x 522). far_w is therefore the opposite jamb of the same opening, which borders the other leaf. View is read as inside: a dark ceiling sits above the head and the street reads through the glazing; if that is wrong the record is still valid for colour and frame. Geometric midpoint falls on glass so colour was taken on paint at the same height (160,625). Warm ivory (rb +23) with a very flat tone profile.
